TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A paneled interior door stands slightly ajar in total darkness, its edges traced by a bright glowing orange rim of light that spills around the frame. Several beams of the same warm light fan out across the floor in the foreground, radiating toward the viewer from the gap at the door's base, giving the scene an eerie, otherworldly quality.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: door

TYPE: meme
SUBJECT: A dark conspiracy-themed infographic collage about public education and the Rockefeller family. Portraits of John D. Rockefeller (left, black-and-white) and David Rockefeller (right, color) flank a central quote block set over a faint United Nations emblem watermark reading VERUM; a smaller black-and-white photo of H. L. Mencken seated in suspenders appears in the lower half beside red and black text panels of quotations about education and social control.
TEXT: "I don't want a nation of thinkers. I want a nation of workers." -John D. Rockefeller / Created the General Education Board (GEB) in 1903 to dispense Rockefeller funds to education / "We are on the verge of a global transformation. All we need is the right major crisis and the nations will accept the New World Order." David Rockefeller. / EDUCATION: Planned Enslavement Through Lack of Knowledge / "The aim of public education is not to spread enlightenment at all, it is simply to reduce as many individuals as possible to the same safe level, to breed and train a standardized citizenry, to put down dissent and originality." H. L. Mencken / EXCERPT FROM Page 7 "Silent Weapons for Quiet Wars" / "The quality of education given to the lower class must be of the poorest sort, so that the moat of ignorance isolating the inferior class from the superior class is and remains incomprehensible to the inferior class. With such an initial handicap, even bright lower class individuals have little if any hope of extricating themselves from their assigned lot in life. This form of slavery is essential to maintain some measure of social order, peace, and tranquillity for the ruling upper class." / Read "Silent Weapons for Quiet Wars" / VERUM (watermark)
SYMBOLS: numbers

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: Viewed from behind, a man with distinctive blonde swept hair (Donald Trump) in a dark suit is at the center of a circle of people who have placed their hands on his shoulders and back in what appears to be a group prayer or blessing. Around him, men in suits bow their heads, including Mike Pence at the left with eyes closed; the foreground hands wear large rings, one with a large teal stone, and a woman's hand with dark polished nails rests on his left shoulder. A photographer with a camera is visible in the background of the wood-paneled room.
TEXT: A (single letter on a green credential badge worn by the man at left)
SYMBOLS: trump

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: An extreme macro close-up of a reptile eye, likely a gecko or snake, filling the frame. The iris is golden-cream mottled with dense rust-orange and black speckles, split by a tall vertical black slit pupil; the surrounding skin is covered in rounded granular scales in tan, brown, and ochre tones that blur softly at the frame edges.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: eye

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A hand-drawn editorial cartoon showing a pair of legs sticking straight up out of a galvanized metal trash can set on a sketchy patch of grass against a teal watercolor-splash background. The legs wear white socks, dark shoes, and rolled-up blue jeans scrawled with the names JOE and BIDEN, while the side of the trash can is painted with the words THE MEDIA in yellow, depicting the former president discarded in a media wastebasket. An artist signature block sits in the lower right corner.
TEXT: JOE / BIDEN / THE MEDIA / RealityBites / 11/06/23 by Broc Smith / www.rofcbybroc.com
SYMBOLS: numbers

TYPE: meme
SUBJECT: A black-and-white close-up of a hand in a dark suit sleeve, with buttons and fringe at the cuff, holding a Jack of Diamonds playing card at its center; the Jack's face is replaced with a small colorized image of Donald Trump's blonde head, the only color in the monochrome image. Bold white text sits in the lower right corner and a vertical watermark runs along the right edge.
TEXT: GAME. ON. / @GRANDOLDMEMES (vertical watermark)

TYPE: meme
SUBJECT: A photograph of a yellow diamond-pattern highway-style caution sign mounted on galvanized posts against a blue sky with cumulus clouds, trees, and utility poles. The sign carries a large black message in highway lettering, with a small circular Team gb logo and website credit in the lower right corner of the sign face.
TEXT: CAUTION / THE MEDIA IS NOT A REFLECTION OF REALITY / TEAM gb / GrowingBolder.com

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A hand cups an open silver skeleton pocket watch against a dark reddish-brown background, the hinged front cover swung down to reveal a white dial with black Arabic numerals 1 through 12 and exposed brass gearwork visible through the open center; a metal watch chain trails from the bottom of the frame and the crown and bow sit at the top of the case.
TEXT: VINCERO (brand on the watch dial)
SYMBOLS: clock, numbers

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A rusted orange gasoline pump nozzle hangs on the metal bracket of a fuel pump, beaded with rain droplets and wrapped in a tangle of frayed blue-and-white baling twine plus a string of small orange beads draped over its handle. The black hose curves down from the nozzle's base, a chrome sheet edge runs down the left of the frame, and the blurred background shows a wet asphalt lot, a red-painted curb, and a dry brown grassy hillside under an overcast sky.
